references.text: Jeremiah describes how the land will become a desolate wasteland and a barren desert, fulfilling the warning in Leviticus.
The Lord declares that the whole land will become a desolate wasteland, but he will not make an end of it completely.
Ezekiel prophesies that the land will become a desolate wasteland, and that the enemies will recognize the Lord's judgment.
The Lord says he will make the land a desolate wasteland, more barren than the desert toward Diblah.
Isaiah describes how the land is ruined, the cities burned, and foreigners devouring the land before their eyes.
Moses warns that the whole land will be scorched, salty, and uncultivated, like Sodom and Gomorrah.
Lamentations describes how enemies mock Jerusalem and scoff at its destruction.
The prophecy that Israel will become a desolate wasteland and that all who pass by will be horrified.
